GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS OF WORK ORDER

1. Scope of Work and Performance
The Service Provider shall perform the work and services specified in the WO, including applicable engineering, design, consultancy, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, supervision, or other activities, as applicable. Work shall conform to the approved drawings, specifications, agreed standards, project requirements, and timelines stated in the WO. Any change in scope, price, or schedule shall require written approval from authorised representatives of both parties.

2. Work Order Acceptance
The WO, together with these Terms and any expressly incorporated documents, shall constitute the agreement between the parties for the relevant engagement. Acceptance shall be evidenced by signature, written confirmation, or commencement of work against the WO. Any additional or conflicting terms proposed by the Service Provider shall not apply unless accepted in writing by the Company.

3. Price, Invoicing and Payment
The agreed rates, fees, milestones, taxes, and payment terms shall be as stated in the WO. Invoices shall be supported by applicable work completion certificates, measurement sheets, approved deliverables, or other agreed supporting documents. The Company shall pay undisputed amounts within [30] days of receipt of a compliant invoice and fulfilment of the applicable payment conditions. Any disputed amount shall be notified with reasonable particulars, and the parties shall work towards resolution; undisputed amounts shall be paid when due. Statutory deductions, including TDS, and applicable GST requirements shall be handled in accordance with law.

4. Timelines, Delays and Changes
The Service Provider shall meet the agreed milestones and promptly notify the Company of any actual or anticipated delay, including its cause and mitigation plan. Extensions attributable to approved scope changes, delayed Company inputs, or qualifying force majeure events shall be assessed fairly and documented in writing. Any delay damages or other contractual remedies shall apply only where expressly specified in the WO and subject to applicable law.

5. Quality, Inspection and Defect Rectification
The Service Provider shall exercise reasonable professional skill, care, and diligence and comply with agreed quality and acceptance criteria. The Company may inspect work and request reasonable supporting records. Inspection, review, payment, or acceptance shall not relieve the Service Provider of its contractual obligations. Defects attributable to the Service Provider shall be rectified within a reasonable period at no additional cost, to the extent covered by the agreed scope and applicable warranty. Any specific warranty period shall be stated in the WO.

6. Health, Safety and Site Compliance
For site-related work, the Service Provider shall comply with applicable health, safety, environmental, labour, and site-access requirements, including lawful instructions and project safety procedures communicated by the Company or principal client. The Service Provider shall provide competent personnel, appropriate protective equipment, and required permits or licences for its activities. Any incident, unsafe condition, property damage, or injury connected with the work shall be promptly reported. Each party shall remain responsible for its own acts, omissions, and legal obligations.

7. Personnel, Statutory Compliance and Insurance
The Service Provider shall ensure that its personnel are appropriately qualified and authorised and that applicable wages, taxes, social security contributions, labour registrations, and other statutory obligations relating to its engagement are fulfilled. Where required by the nature of the work or specified in the WO, the Service Provider shall maintain appropriate insurance, including employee compensation, public liability, or professional indemnity cover, and provide evidence upon request. Nothing in these Terms shall override the actual legal status or statutory rights of any individual.

8. Confidentiality and Data Protection
The Service Provider shall protect all confidential business information, client details, drawings, designs, technical documents, pricing, project records, and data received or accessed during the engagement. Such information shall be used only for the WO and shall not be disclosed without prior written consent, except as required by law. The Service Provider shall apply reasonable security measures and promptly notify the Company of any suspected unauthorised disclosure or loss. Upon completion or termination, Company information shall be returned or securely deleted, subject to applicable legal retention requirements. These obligations shall survive termination.

9. Intellectual Property and Project Documents
Project-specific drawings, reports, calculations, designs, specifications, models, documents, and other deliverables shall be owned or licensed by the Company as expressly specified in the WO or a separate written agreement. Any assignment of intellectual property shall be documented in writing and specify the applicable rights, duration, territory, and consideration as required by law. The Service Provider shall identify pre-existing intellectual property and third-party materials incorporated into the deliverables and shall not incorporate restricted materials without prior approval and appropriate usage rights. The Company shall respect any pre-existing rights expressly reserved by the Service Provider.

10. Subcontracting and Conflicts of Interest
The Service Provider shall not assign the WO or subcontract material obligations without the Company's prior written consent. Approved subcontracting shall not relieve the Service Provider of its responsibilities under the WO. The Service Provider shall disclose any actual conflict of interest and shall not engage in fraud, bribery, or unlawful conduct in connection with the engagement.

11. Liability and Indemnity
Each party shall be responsible for losses to the extent arising from its breach of contract, negligence, wilful misconduct, or violation of applicable law. The Service Provider shall indemnify the Company against third-party claims, direct losses, and reasonable costs to the extent caused by the Service Provider's proven breach, negligence, wilful misconduct, or infringement of third-party intellectual property rights. The affected party shall promptly notify the other party of relevant claims and reasonably cooperate in their defence. Any liability cap, exclusions, or additional indemnities shall be expressly agreed in the WO. Nothing in this clause excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

12. Suspension and Termination
Either party may terminate the WO for a material breach by the other party if the breach remains unremedied for [15] days after written notice, where capable of remedy. The Company may suspend work for reasonable project, safety, compliance, or operational grounds by written notice. Either party may terminate for prolonged force majeure or other grounds expressly stated in the WO. On termination, the Service Provider shall stop the affected work, protect work in progress, return Company property, and hand over completed deliverables for which payment is due. The Company shall pay for conforming services properly performed up to the termination date, together with any other amounts expressly payable under the WO, subject to agreed adjustments and applicable law.

13. Force Majeure
Neither party shall be liable for failure or delay to the extent directly caused by an event beyond its reasonable control that could not reasonably have been prevented or overcome. The affected party shall promptly notify the other party, provide reasonable particulars, and take steps to mitigate the impact. If the event continues beyond [30] days, either party may seek a mutually agreed solution or exercise any termination right specified in the WO. Amounts due for work already performed shall remain payable in accordance with the WO.

14. Dispute Resolution and Governing Law
The parties shall first attempt to resolve disputes through good-faith discussions between their authorised representatives. If unresolved within [30] days, the dispute shall be referred to [mutually agreed arbitration / competent courts], as specified in the WO. The agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. The agreed venue or seat of arbitration, if applicable, and the competent court jurisdiction shall be specified in the WO, subject to applicable law.

15. General Provisions and Order of Precedence
The WO, these Terms, and expressly incorporated schedules shall be read together. In case of inconsistency, the specific WO provisions shall prevail only to the extent of the inconsistency, unless expressly agreed otherwise in writing. Amendments must be documented in writing by authorised representatives. If any provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue to the extent permitted by law. Provisions relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, accrued payments, liability, and dispute resolution shall survive to the extent necessary after completion or termination.

Acknowledgement: Acceptance of the WO constitutes acceptance of these Terms, subject to applicable law and the agreed contractual documents.
